C1708.title: Microsoft Detects Growing Use of File Hosting Services in Business Email Compromise Attacks
C1708.summary: Microsoft warns that attackers are increasingly abusing legitimate file hosting services such as SharePoint, OneDrive, and Dropbox as a defense evasion tactic to compromise identities and devices and carry out business email compromise (BEC) attacks. These services, widely used for enterprise collaboration, are being exploited to deliver phishing links or exfiltrate data through shared file links.
